summary: Verified the _intent UnboundLocalError fix in _stream_one_provider. The GLOBAL CLASSIFIER block now sits above the provider switch and assigns `_intent` + `_has_content` exactly once for ALL providers (Anthropic, emergent_anthropic, openai_direct, moonshot), with safe fallback values on classifier exception. 5/5 new regression tests pass, AND all 81 prior tests pass — total 86/86.

verification_details.intent_assignment_count_file: `_intent = classify_user_intent` appears EXACTLY ONCE in freebuild_agent.py (line 9059). No duplicate inside Anthropic branch.
verification_details.has_content_assignment_count_file: `_has_content = bool(` appears EXACTLY ONCE in freebuild_agent.py (line 9058).
verification_details.provider_branch_position: Line 9065 `if provider in ("anthropic", "emergent_anthropic"):` sits directly AFTER the GLOBAL CLASSIFIER block — confirmed both by grep and by inspect.getsource of _stream_one_provider.
verification_details.downstream_references_safe: Real SURGICAL-HARDBLOCK at line 9249 and DESIGN-DESTRUCTION GUARD at line 9695 both reside AFTER the classifier and AFTER the provider branch — `_intent` is guaranteed defined when they read it for every provider path.
verification_details.fallback_values_present: `_intent = "new_build"` and `_has_content = False` are set inside the `except Exception` of the global classifier — downstream code cannot hit UnboundLocalError even if classify_user_intent raises.
verification_details.inspect_getsource_order: Within inspect.getsource(_stream_one_provider): GLOBAL CLASSIFIER comment offset=2815 < _has_content=3125 < _intent=3247 < provider branch=3483 < real SURGICAL-HARDBLOCK=13995 < real DESIGN-DESTRUCTION GUARD=42656. Strict ordering confirmed.

test_results.test_openai_param_compat.py: 12/12 PASS — no regression on iteration 53-55 fixes

critical_code_review_comments: Fix correctly lifts `_intent` and `_has_content` to function-level scope before any provider dispatch. The try/except wraps both assignments and provides deterministic fallbacks (`new_build`, False), so downstream guards cannot UnboundLocalError regardless of classifier failure mode.

Defensive note (non-blocking): The fallback `_intent = 'new_build'` is the SAFER default for the SURGICAL-HARDBLOCK (it leaves write_full_html available) but the LESS safe default for the DESIGN-DESTRUCTION GUARD (which only fires on surgical). If classify_user_intent ever silently misclassifies a true surgical edit as new_build via this fallback, design-destruction guard won't fire. Acceptable tradeoff — preferable to crashing — but worth a counter/metric in logs to track fallback hit-rate.
Single-source assignment (count == 1 in entire freebuild_agent.py) eliminates the shadowing risk the original test guarded against.
test_credentials: n/a — pure source-introspection + deterministic unit tests, no network or auth required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 56 confirms the third Hybrid-mode bug (UnboundLocalError on `_intent` when provider == openai_direct) is fully resolved. The GLOBAL CLASSIFIER block at freebuild_agent.py:9053-9063 runs unconditionally before the provider switch at line 9065 and assigns both `_intent` and `_has_content` with try/except fallback. All 86 backend tests pass (5 new + 81 prior). No regression on iterations 53-55 fixes (OpenAI 128-tool limit + max_completion_tokens). If future edits to _stream_one_provider re-introduce a branch-local `_intent = classify_user_intent`, test_no_duplicate_intent_assignment_inside_anthropic_branch will catch it immediately.
rca_of_the_issue: RCA: Pre-fix, `_intent` and `_has_content` were assigned only inside the `if provider in ('anthropic', 'emergent_anthropic'):` branch (~line 9075). When the Hybrid mode router chose `openai_direct` for first_design intent, that branch was skipped and the downstream SURGICAL-HARDBLOCK (L9237) plus DESIGN-DESTRUCTION GUARD (L9693) referenced an undefined local. Mitigation: main agent extracted classification into a GLOBAL CLASSIFIER block (L9053-9063) that runs once at the top of _stream_one_provider with try/except and safe fallback (`_intent='new_build'`, `_has_content=False`). Verification: source grep confirms single assignment site; inspect.getsource confirms ordering; 5 new regression tests + 81 prior tests all green.
